<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Agadir Concept — Univers de design
 * Description: Reproduit les quinze maquettes validées avec des compositions dédiées, configurables et réversibles.
 * Version: 4.0.0
 * Requires at least: 6.7
 * Requires PHP: 8.1
 * Requires Plugins: elementor
 * Author: Agadir Concept
 * Text Domain: agadir-concept-design-universes
 *
 * @package AgadirConceptDesignUniverses
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

define( 'ACDU_VERSION', '4.0.0' );
define( 'ACDU_FILE', __FILE__ );
define( 'ACDU_PATH', plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'ACDU_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );

require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-page-map.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-template-data.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-template-builder.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-provisioner.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-plugin.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-admin.php';

register_activation_hook( __FILE__, array( 'Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\\Plugin', 'activate' ) );

add_action(
	'plugins_loaded',
	static function (): void {
		Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Plugin::instance()->boot();
	}
);

/**
 * Provision the approved site structure once for this release.
 */
add_action(
	'init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( ACDU_VERSION === (string) get_option( 'acdu_structure_version', '' ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$result = Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Provisioner::provision();

		if ( empty( $result['failed'] ) ) {
			update_option( 'acdu_structure_version', ACDU_VERSION, false );
		}
	},
	5
);

add_filter(
	'agadir_concept_bridge_apply_page_package',
	static function ( $result, string $plugin_dir, array $context ) {
		unset( $context );
		if ( 'agadir-concept-design-universes' !== sanitize_key( $plugin_dir ) ) {
			return $result;
		}

		return array(
			'ok'        => true,
			'version'   => ACDU_VERSION,
			'provision' => Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Provisioner::provision(),
		);
	},
	10,
	3
);
